title: The YouTube ad-block wall, gone for good.
body: Killed the “ad blockers violate YouTube’s Terms” pop-up that came back on every refresh.
items: Now strips ads from the very first video on page load and hard-refresh, not just when you click between videos — the wall can’t trigger anymore.
If a wall ever does slip through, it’s removed instantly and playback resumes on its own.

title: Chat can clip the stream now.
body: Viewers type !clip and get an instant, shareable Twitch clip — no clip software, no waiting for the VOD.
items: New !clip chat command: anyone clips the stream and gets a shareable link instantly.
Set the command, cooldown and reply — and optionally save a local copy at your exact length via OBS.

title: The Command Center.
body: The biggest release yet — a whole new dashboard, multi-streamer profiles, and one-click setup for everything.
items: New Command Center dashboard with a quick-action home, Ctrl+K search and a fresh theme.
Channel-point sound alerts, YouTube song requests, watch-time points, a leaderboard and giveaways.
Multi-streamer profiles — run a whole roster from one install.
Go-live announcements to Discord (one-click connect), live session stats, and stream markers for your editor.
One-click add overlays to OBS, plus instant Spotify & Discord setup. Import from StreamElements too.

title: A full overlay studio lands.
body: The biggest update yet — customizable overlays, chat-voted polls, shareable setups and more.
items: New overlays: goal bars, scenes (Starting Soon / BRB / Ending), a subathon timer, social bar, webcam frame and a Spotify now-playing widget.
Highlight a chat message on stream, run chat-voted polls, and answer FAQs with a built-in !commands bot.
Tip alerts via StreamElements & Streamlabs, plus a profanity filter for read-outs.
Share your whole setup — alerts, overlays and media — as one .smpack file.
Auto-start with Windows, global mute/replay hotkeys, and in-app previews of every overlay.

title: Unified chat overlay — every platform, one widget.
body: Read Twitch, Kick, YouTube & TikTok chat together — on stream or as a pop-out.
items: Unified chat overlay: Twitch, Kick, YouTube & TikTok in one widget, each line tagged by platform.
Add it to OBS, or pop it out as an always-on-top window to read while you play.
One-click voice-engine setup — no terminal, no manual installs.
Auto-fetches the media tools (ffmpeg) it needs on first use.
Getting-started checklist, in-app alert text & volume editing, replay-last-alert, and a reconnect indicator.

title: Twitch chat overlay + QoL pass.
body: Newest app in the suite keeps stacking Twitch extras.
items: Full-screen chat overlay — read chat without dropping out of fullscreen.
Drag the overlay anywhere on screen; it stays where you put it.
Messages fade out after a few seconds so chat never clutters the stream.
Lighter CPU use and a self-healing controls panel under the hood.

title: Local-first stream alerts ship.
body: The newest app in the suite — instant alerts, fired on your own PC.
items: Instant Twitch alerts over a local EventSub connection — no cloud round-trip.
One-click Botrix import pulls every alert and its media to your disk.
Built-in clip trimmer + one-button loudness-normalize (−16 LUFS).
Donor messages read aloud in a voice you cloned, synthesized on your GPU.
Stream-delay detect + sync. Signed installer with auto-update.

title: Performance + correctness audit.
body: A pass of perf and bug fixes: throttled the profile-flair DOM observer, recycled tier-flair nodes, mass-delete 429 backoff, migration data-loss guard, VIP-status caching, Tournament Mode reload-restore, and audio-constraint fixes on screenshare. Same 288 MB footprint, fewer wakeups.

title: The hundred-tweak catalog.
body: Audited catalog crosses 100 sourced tweaks — every one still cited to a Microsoft Learn doc, vendor whitepaper, or NVIDIA dev note. Snapshot-backed revert on all of them.

title: The blocker they couldn't ban — live.
body: New to the suite: one ad blocker that loads where the others got banned.
items: Manifest V3-native — installs on Brave, Chrome, Edge and Firefox, no "unsupported" wall.
Blocks YouTube, Spotify and Twitch ads.
Keeps Twitch at full 1080p60 instead of dropping you to 480p.
21,370 EasyList + EasyPrivacy rules, per-site pause, weekly self-update.

title: Profile-flair URL hardening.
body: Avatar/banner inputs now reject page-host links (TikTok, YouTube, Imgur-page, Reddit-page, Twitter/X, Twitch, Insta, FB, Vimeo) at all four entry points, with a friendly toast pointing at a catbox rehost. Direct CDN siblings still pass.

title: Screenshare echo, gone.
body: Sender-side echo cancellation fix — both parties on a call run echo-free once they're on v0.7.25+. No more hearing yourself a beat late when someone shares their screen.

title: Production cut.
body: Votes-worker real tally backend. Tier ladder + checkout shipped. Page-hero demo live on /discordmaxxer.

title: Discord server live.
body: Permanent invite at discord.gg/S78eecbWdx. 6 channels, 7 silent product threads, 3 tier roles, ticket panel + VIP-claim worker live.

title: Veno-quote pack + product demo.
body: 5 verbatim Veno quotes shipped on /grind cards. Page-hero demo + TikTok cut both live on /optimizationmaxxing — synced to a hand-picked Yeat track.

title: Per-game auto-pin daemon.
body: sysinfo poll → SetProcessDefaultCpuSets. Set-and-forget. Config at %LOCALAPPDATA%\optmaxxing\auto-pin.json. Tournament Mode runs without you remembering.

title: Click-to-pin CPU Sets API.
body: Right-click a process, pin its threads to specific cores via the CPU Sets API. AC tags 12 → 18.

title: Tournament Mode.
body: One-toggle competitive preset. Standby memory cleaner integrated. AC tags 3 → 12.

title: VIP claim worker.
body: Cloudflare Worker live at optmaxxing-vip.maxxtopia.workers.dev. HWID-locked codes shared cross-product — discordmaxxer + optmaxxing on the same rig redeem off the same code.

title: The shell is live.
body: maxxtopia.com goes online — hub for the maxxer apps. Cross-product sidebar, finite-rotate hero with sound, status-tape coming-soon treatment, per-product logos for opt + discord.

title: Research-driven mega-batch.
body: Catalog 68 → 87. IntelMicrocodeCard, VbsStatusCard, live DPC sparkline (1-Hz toggle). HID priority quartet, vbs.hvci.disable, IFEO priority for Fortnite/Valorant/CS2, 9 service kills, telemetry-batch task disable.

title: Knowledge-audit gap closure.
body: 4 confident additions: Latency Probe on Toolkit, PCIe Link card on Diagnostics, AMD UCLK heuristic warning, Discord low-FPS research article.

title: Audit deferral pass.
body: DPC migrated to per-NUMA/per-CCD counter source. NIC tweaks probe-and-log with vendor-tolerant fallbacks. formFactor desktop/laptop targeting. 5 laptop-hostile tweaks tagged desktop-only.

title: Audit-driven correctness pass.
body: Catalog 78 → 68 honest tweaks. Cut 10 placebos. Fixed 2 wrong values. Fixed 2 revert bugs. Rebuilt Network Low-Latency around tweaks that actually work. Principle: every tweak must trade off verifiably.

title: FileWrite engine action.
body: New TweakAction::FileWrite variant. Snapshot-backed byte-perfect revert (≤1 MB cap), env-var path expansion, user-profile vs admin routing. Catalog can now ship .ini / .nip / .cfg tweaks.

title: DPC + Interrupt Time card.
body: Backend WMI Win32_PerfFormattedData_PerfOS_Processor. UI: 2 big stats + per-CPU expandable + Save baseline + diff column. Color thresholds (green ≤2% / red >5%). Apply-preset measurable before/after.

title: First production cut.
body: Tournament Mode v3 ships. Sub-300 MB RAM at idle vs 1041 MB on stock. Full plugin set (Cursor, Privacy, Trim + 7 more), 5-theme system, Apple-grade icon, custom sounds.

title: Mega-batch v0.1.25.
body: 70 tweaks total (+5 curated). New /changelog page, sitemap.xml + robots.txt. SystemHealth gains category-filtered hint. Compare matrix gains free-text search.

title: Premise-first reset.
body: Pipeline now ships shippable clips on 2 streamers (Dasnerth 4/5, Pilat 2/2). HUD wedge code deleted. Mission locked: auto-clip + auto-post for streamers.
